description: Send each DataFrame row to a Kafka topic as a JSON message. Destination-side counterpart to kafka_monitor / kafka_to_database_asset, which only consume from Kafka.

inputs.description: DataFrame whose rows become Kafka messages

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset key of the upstream DataFrame asset

topic.label: Topic
topic.description: Fixed Kafka topic to publish every row to. Set this OR topic_column, not both.

bootstrap_servers.label: Bootstrap Servers
bootstrap_servers.description: Comma-separated Kafka broker addresses (e.g. 'broker1:9092,broker2:9092'). Set this OR bootstrap_servers_env_var OR resource_key.

bootstrap_servers_env_var.label: Bootstrap Servers Env Var
bootstrap_servers_env_var.description: Env var holding the Kafka bootstrap servers. Set this OR bootstrap_servers OR resource_key.

security_protocol.label: Security Protocol
security_protocol.description: Kafka security protocol (PLAINTEXT, SSL, SASL_PLAINTEXT, SASL_SSL). Ignored when resource_key is set.

sasl_mechanism.label: Sasl Mechanism
sasl_mechanism.description: SASL mechanism when using SASL_PLAINTEXT or SASL_SSL (e.g. PLAIN, SCRAM-SHA-256). Ignored when resource_key is set.

sasl_username_env_var.label: Sasl Username Env Var
sasl_username_env_var.description: Env var holding the SASL username. Ignored when resource_key is set.

sasl_password_env_var.label: Sasl Password Env Var
sasl_password_env_var.description: Env var holding the SASL password. Ignored when resource_key is set.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Optional Dagster resource key providing a pre-configured Kafka client. When set, context.resources.<resource_key>.get_producer() is called instead of building a KafkaProducer from the other fields. Compatible with KafkaResourceComponent (resources/kafka_resource).

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Optional column whose value becomes each message's Kafka key (UTF-8 encoded). Messages with the same key land on the same partition, preserving per-key ordering. Unset: no key, round-robin partitioning.

partition_strategy.label: Partition Strategy
partition_strategy.description: Kafka partition strategy, mirroring StreamSets Kafka Producer's 'Partition Strategy' field: 'default' (no explicit partition is set -- key_column, if any, drives the client's own hash partitioner, else its default/round-robin behavior), 'round_robin' (explicitly cycle through the topic's partitions in order, ignoring key_column), 'random' (pick a random partition per message), or 'expression' (use partition_column's integer value as the exact partition number for that row -- StreamSets' Expression strategy).

partition_column.label: Partition Column
partition_column.description: Column whose integer value is used as the explicit destination partition number. Required when partition_strategy='expression', ignored otherwise.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Rows sent per flush() call. Does not cap total rows sent — only how often the producer's buffer is flushed.

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:analytics) or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog, e.g. {"domain": "finance"}.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog (e.g. snowflake, python). Auto-inferred from component name if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

topic_column.label: Topic Column
topic_column.description: Column whose value is this row's destination topic, so different rows can publish to different topics (e.g. a StreamSets Kafka Producer 'topic expression' migrated from a per-record field). Set this OR topic, not both. A row whose column value is null/missing is skipped with a logged warning, not sent to a 'None' topic.
